title: Portfolio management
audience: a college student in a finance, accounting or business degree program, or a career changer studying the same material on their own
purpose: Write an investment policy statement, set strategic and tactical asset allocation, build and rebalance portfolios, manage equity, fixed income and alternative investments, measure and attribute performance, and manage risk with VaR and stress tests.
primary_reading: CFA Institute Research Foundation: free monographs and briefs

weeks.8: Risk management: VaR and stress testing
weeks.12: Ethics and fiduciary duty in portfolio management

blocks.deliverable: Write an IPS for an individual investor.
Build a strategic allocation from capital market assumptions.
Compare passive and active equity strategies.
Week 7 midterm; compute VaR three ways.
Attribute returns with the Brinson model.
Explain three conflicts of interest and their remedies.
Submit the project; take an unseen 120 minute final in week 14.

project: Managed portfolio: for an assigned client, write an investment policy statement, build and justify a strategic allocation, implement it with real funds or indexes, simulate a year with rebalancing in Python, attribute the results, and present a client report.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
